data.one_liner: Cross‑platform abstraction for querying runtime platform info in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a unified API to access native and web platform details, with mock support for tests. It wraps dart:io Platform on native runtimes and exposes browser data on the web.
use_when: Need to detect OS or browser in a single API
Build apps that run on multiple Dart platforms without conditional imports
avoid_when: You only target a single platform and want minimal dependencies
You need advanced device features beyond basic platform info
weaknesses: Limited to platform info only, no device capabilities
Requires manual null checks for web vs native
API changes in 3.2.0 may need migration

alternatives.name: plugin_platform_interface
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a base for platform interfaces but requires custom implementation

alternatives.name: browser_launcher
alternatives.why_pick_it: Only for web browser detection, not cross‑platform
